Sika® ViscoCrete®-1250 is a third generation superplasticiser used to produce soft plastic concrete as well as state of the art, self compacting concrete (SCC) depending on dose rate.

cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer
cl.l: Sika® ViscoCrete®-1250 is suitable for the production of the following types of concrete
s: Hot weather concrete and concrete with extended transportation or placing time.
Concrete requiring high water reduction.
High strength concrete.
Self-compacting concrete (SCC) or Super workable concrete.

cl.c: Data sheet pages 1-2: Application Information > Recommended dosage
cl.x: Typical dosage for soft concrete production is 350 ml - 1500 ml per 100 kg of total cementitious material. For self-compacting concrete, typical dosage is 900 ml - 3000 ml per 100kg of total cementitious material.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Information > Dispensing
cl.x: Sika® ViscoCrete®-1250 is added together with the batching water. For optimum utilisation of the high range water reduction we recommend thorough mixing at a minimum wet mixing time of 60 seconds per cubic metre after the admixture addition. The addition of the slump water, to fine tune concrete consistency, should only be started after 2/3 of the wet mixing time after the admixture addition, to avoid surplus water in the concrete. Do not add to a dry mix.

cl.l: When using Sika® ViscoCrete®-1250 actual setting time will depend on site conditions. This should be checked and predetermined with trial mixes.
s: Special mix designs are required to achieve Self Compacting Concrete (SCC)
Not recommended for use with normal range water reducers.
Please check compatibility when using with other admixtures.
Do not use with naphthalene-based admixtures.
For additional information, please contact your local Sika Representative.
